# Reset both sides of reused chat account visibility state

am-im.js reuses the account pane for different protocols. It sets imTabEncryption.hidden to true when encryption cannot be configured and to false when it can, then sets the OTR and protocol encryption sections separately. ChatEncryption.canConfigureEncryption returns true for enabled OTR or protocol.canEncrypt. Entry 773 fixes the unsupported branch so switching from a supported account does not leave the tab visible. Manual state review proposal for reused panes: assign both positive and negative states on every account initialization. Capability names should state whether settings can be configured; available encryption, trusted encryption and enabled encryption are different concepts. No direct account-switch regression test was added in this commit.

Scope: chat-account-capability.
